name: Wall beasts

variantInfo.name: Wall beast
notes: Max hit 4 in normal melee, but 18 in the grab attack that lands if you fight one without a spiny helmet or Slayer helmet.
A spiny helmet (or Slayer helmet) is required to start fighting one; without it you are grabbed and hurt with no chance to retaliate.
No elemental weakness (honest null); all defensive bonuses are 0.

locationComparison.name: Lumbridge Swamp Caves
notes: Seven wall beasts in the Lumbridge Swamp Caves, lurking in the cave walls; a light source is required.
A spiny helmet or Slayer helmet must be worn before attacking one.
A Dwarf multicannon can be used here.

taskNotes: SYNTHETIC slayerTargetId 304 (252-305 C2/C3 block): the real SLAYER_TARGET varp for Wall beasts is not wiki-published; QA live-verify.
Assigned only by Mazchna (10-20) in this dataset; requires Slayer level 35. Mazchna's combat-level threshold is around 30.
A spiny helmet or Slayer helmet is required to fight wall beasts safely; without it they land an 18-damage grab. The requiredItemId is honest-UNKNOWN (spiny helmet item id not wiki-published).
No elemental weakness (weakness.element honest null); all defensive bonuses are 0 so any accurate melee works.
lumbridge-swamp-caves is referenced by id (owned by cave-bugs, CT-L shared #1); its accessNote already documents the spiny helmet and cannon.
recommendedMethod: Wear a spiny helmet or Slayer helmet before attacking a wall beast, otherwise it grabs you for up to 18 damage with no chance to retaliate. Bring a light source into the Lumbridge Swamp Caves and clear the seven spawns with any accurate melee weapon; a Dwarf multicannon speeds the task. They have no elemental weakness and all defensive bonuses are 0.
